'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[UNICEF]] says that 10,000 children have been either killed or injured in [[Yemen]] since [[Saudi Arabia]] started bombing the country in 2015 in reaction to the [[Islamist]] [[Houthis]]' ousting of the [[government of Yemen|government]]. This equates to an average of four children killed or injured every day since the start of the conflict. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/unicef-says-10000-children-killed-or-maimed-yemen-since-2015-2021-10-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Defence minister [[Sadio Camara]] asks Mali's main Islamic body, the [[High Islamic Council of Mali|High Islamic Council]], to mediate peace talks between the [[government of Mali|government]] and the local branch of [[al-Qaeda]], [[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin]]. The move is strongly opposed by [[France]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/19/mali-asks-islamic-body-to-open-negotiations-with-al-qaeda (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****[[Bulgaria]] launches its [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 Green Certificate]] which indicates that a person is either [[COVID-19 vaccination in Bulgaria|vaccinated]], has [[COVID-19 testing|tested negative]], or has recovered from COVID-19. The certificate will be mandatory for all indoor activities beginning on October 21. [https://m.novinite.com/articles/211906/Bulgaria+Introduces+COVID-19+%E2%80%9CGreen+Certificate%E2%80%9D+for+All+Indoor+Activities+from+October+21 (Novinite)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Moscow]] [[Mayor of Moscow|Mayor]] [[Sergei Sobyanin]] announces a [[stay-at-home order]] for unvaccinated or unrecovered people age 60 years and older for four months and ordering businesses to shift 30% of their workers to remote work beginning from October 25 due to record 1,015 deaths in [[Russia]] over the past 24 hours. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/virus-outbreak-russia-1.6216445 (CBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[United Kingdom]] reports 233 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of daily deaths since March 3. [https://inews.co.uk/news/covid-deaths-cases-daily-uk-coronavirus-lockdown-1257138 (Inews.co.uk)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta subvariant]] "AY4.2" in a boy who travelled from [[Moldova]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/first-case-of-new-delta-mutation-ay4-2-diagnosed-in-israel/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports a record 3,994 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 154,725. [https://www.todayonline.com/singapore/singapore-logs-3994-new-covid-19-cases-moh-urges-people-limit-social-activities-icu (''Today'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[New Zealand]] reports a record 94 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/oct/19/new-zealand-covid-cases-rise-to-new-record-as-young-people-bear-brunt-of-infections (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in South Africa]]
***The [[South African Health Products Regulatory Authority]] rejects the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine]] due to some safety concerns the manufacturer wasn’t able to answer such as failed [[HIV vaccine]]s that use Adenovirus Type 5 that are similar to the Russian-made vaccine. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-technology-business-russia-coronavirus-vaccine-5b95d498a530240a772b8c9e43070d88 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International Atomic Energy Agency]] chief [[Rafael Grossi]] says that he plans to visit [[Iran]] by the end of November in an effort to revive the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/un-atomic-agency-head-visit-iran-pressure-ramps-revival-nuclear-deal-1640569 (''Newsweek'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[National responses to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***The [[Brazilian Senate]] releases a report recommending that [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] should face criminal charges for homicide regarding his response to the COVID-19 pandemic in [[Brazil|the country]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazils-bolsonaro-should-face-homicide-charge-covid-19-errors-senate-report-2021-10-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Leverkusen explosion]]
**Three people are [[criminal charge|charged]] in [[Germany]] for killing and causing an explosion by recklessness at a chemical park in [[Leverkusen]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], in July. Seven people were killed and 31 others were injured. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-charged-over-deadly-chemicals-blast-germany-2021-10-19/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] announces that it has raided the [[Washington, D.C.]] house of [[Russian oligarch]] and [[Vladimir Putin]] ally [[Oleg Deripaska]], who was sanctioned by the [[United States Department of the Treasury|U.S. Treasury Department]] in 2018. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/10/19/fbi-raids-us-properties-of-sanctioned-russian-oligarch-a75341 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*Global [[investment bank]] [[Credit Suisse]] agrees to pay a [[United States dollar|US$]]475 million fine to U.S. and British authorities after pleading guilty to [[Conspiracy (criminal)|conspiring]] [[wire fraud]] towards investors, which violated the [[anti-corruption]] law of [[Mozambique]] regarding [[Bond (finance)|bond]] offerings. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/business-and-tech/20211019-credit-suisse-to-pay-475-mn-to-settle-us-uk-charges-on-mozambique-bond-offer (AFP via RFI)]
